caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned at a three-quarter angle, showing both the seat and backrest. The chair is light to medium brown, with wood grain details visible throughout the seat, legs, and backrest. The chair features two horizontal slats forming the backrest, supported by two vertical posts that are slightly angled backward. The seat is rectangular with rounded edges and shows a subtle sheen indicating its smooth, finished surface. The four legs of the chair are rounded, with the two front legs displaying turned details, while the rear legs are straight and angled backward. There are three horizontal stretchers connecting the legs near the bottom: one each between the two sides and one at the front connecting the two front legs. The drawing is set against a plain, beige background, and there are no additional objects or elements besides the wooden chair. The artist's signature, "E Eastham," is visible near the lower right part of the composition.
title: Kitchen Chair
